questions.q: In a competitive exam with 120 questions, there are three sections: General knowledge (20 questions), Reasoning (50 questions), and English (50 questions). A candidate answered $70\%$ of General knowledge, $50\%$ of Reasoning, and $30\%$ of English questions correctly. If the minimum passing score is $60\%$, how many more questions did the candidate need to answer correctly to pass? (CGL TIER I - 15/09/2025 - S3)
questions.s: Dekh bhai TestRipper, total 120 questions hain aur pass hone ke liye $60\%$ chahiye, yani $120 \times 0.60 = 72$ questions sahi hone zaroori hain. Usne sahi kiye kitne? GK me $20$ ka $70\% = 14$. Reasoning me $50$ ka $50\% = 25$. English me $50$ ka $30\% = 15$. Total sahi hue: $14 + 25 + 15 = 54$. Pass hone ke liye aur kitne chahiye? $72 - 54 = 18$. Basic counting ka sawal tha, dimaag me hi solve ho jana chahiye tha!

questions.q: $50\%$ of the students in a school play cricket, $40\%$ of the students play football and the number of students who play both the games is 420. The number of students who play neither cricket nor football is $45\%$. Find the number of students in the college?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, Venn diagram ki sabse mast trick laga! $45\%$ bachhe kuch nahi khelte, iska seedha matlab hai ki bache hue $55\%$ kuch na kuch khelte hain (yani $C \cup F = 55\%$). Formula laga: $C \cup F = C + F - (C \cap F)$. Value daal de: $55 = 50 + 40 - \text{Both} \implies \text{Both} = 35\%$. Question me diya hai ki ye $35\%$ bachhe 420 ke barabar hain. Agar $35\% = 420$ hai, toh $1\% = 12$ hoga. Total students ($100\%$) honge 1200. Faltu diagrams mat banana paper me!

questions.q: $20\%$ of the voters did not cast their vote in an election between two candidates. $10\%$ of the votes polled were found invalid. The successful candidate got $56\%$ of the valid votes and won by a majority of 1728 votes. The number of voters enrolled on the voters list was?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, successive fractions se udha isko. Total votes $T$ maan le. Polled hue $80\%$ (yani $0.8T$). Valid hue polled ke $90\%$ (yani $0.8T \times 0.9 = 0.72T$). Winner ko $56\%$ mile valid ke, toh loser ko mile honge $100\% - 56\% = 44\%$. Margin kitna hua? $56\% - 44\% = 12\%$. Kiska $12\%$? Valid votes ka! Toh equation bani: $12\%$ of $0.72T = 1728 \implies 0.12 \times 0.72T = 1728 \implies 0.0864T = 1728$. Decimal hata aur T nikal, seedha 20000 aayega. Calculation ki speed CGL me rank banati hai!

questions.q: If the length of a rectangle is increased by $12\%$ and the width is decreased by $8\%$, the net effect on the area is?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, Successive percentage (AB Rule) ka classic case. Area = Length $\times$ Width, toh seedha formula: $x + y + \frac{xy}{100}$. Yaha $x = +12$ aur $y = -8$ hai. Laga de formula: $12 - 8 - \frac{12 \times 8}{100} = 4 - 0.96 = +3.04\%$. Positive aaya matlab Increase by $3.04\%$. Bina pen uthaye solve karne wala sawal tha!

questions.q: The profits of three partners are in the ratio 2: 3: 4. If their profits increase by $50\%$, $40\%$, and $30\%$ respectively, what is the new ratio of profits? (CHSL TIER I - 19/11/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s: Dekh bhai, base values ko seedha unke naye multipliers se multiply maar de. $50\%$ badhna matlab $1.5$ guna hona, $40\%$ matlab $1.4$, aur $30\%$ matlab $1.3$. Naya ratio banega: $(2 \times 1.5) : (3 \times 1.4) : (4 \times 1.3) = 3 : 4.2 : 5.2$. Options match kar rahe hain exact. Zero laga ke solve karne me mat ulajhna, decimal direct match ho raha hai!

questions.q: A number is first increased by $12\%$ and then increased by $23\%$. The number, so obtained, is now decreased by $34\%$. What is the net increase or decrease percent in the original number (nearest to an integer)?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, 3 baar successive lagega, aur fractions bohot ajeeb hain isliye ratio nahi multipliers use kar. Net multiplier $= 1.12 \times 1.23 \times 0.66$. Calculation fast kar: $1.12 \times 1.23 \approx 1.3776$. Ab isko $0.66$ se kar: $1.3776 \times 0.66 \approx 0.9092$. Pehle number $1$ tha ab $0.909$ reh gaya, yani lagbhag $0.091$ ka nuksan. Percentage me ye $9.1\%$ ka decrease banta hai. Nearest integer pucha hai, toh $9\%$ decrease! Approximation tricks life bachaati hain.

questions.q: Ravi scores $40\%$ marks and fails by 30 marks. Sohan scores $50\%$ marks and gets 20 marks more than the pass marks. Find the maximum marks of the exam. (CHSL TIER I - 14/11/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s: Dekh bhai, marks difference vs percentage difference ka funda laga. Ek $40\%$ laya aur 30 marks se pichad gaya ($-30$). Dusra $50\%$ laya aur 20 marks aage nikal gaya ($+20$). Dono ke percentage ka gap $= 10\%$. Marks ka gap $= 20 - (-30) = 50$. Agar maximum marks ka $10\% = 50$ hai, toh poora $100\%$ kitna hoga? Ek zero aur chipka de: $500$. Ye paper me pen uthane layak nahi hai!

questions.q: A student gets a total of $80\%$ marks in five subjects in the ratio of 10:8:6:4:2. If the passing marks are $30\%$ of the maximum marks and the maximum marks for each subject are the same, then in how many subjects does he pass the examination?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, tagda logically-framed question hai! Har subject ka max marks same hai, maan le 100-100 (Total 500). Pass marks $30\%$ yani 30 hain. Usne overall $80\%$ score kiya, yani total marks $= 400$. Uske marks ratio $10:8:6:4:2$ me hain (sum = 30 unit). $30\text{ unit} = 400 \implies 1\text{ unit} = 40/3 = 13.33$. Uske actual marks kya hue? $10\times13.33=133.3$, $8\times13.33=106.6$, $6\times13.33=80$, $4\times13.33=53.3$, $2\times13.33=26.6$. Pass hone ke liye 30 chahiye. Upar ke 4 subjects me 30 se zyada hain, bas last wale me 26.6 hain jisme fail hua. Toh 4 subjects me pass!

questions.q: In a manufacturing unit, it was noted that the price of raw material has increased by $12.5\%$ and the labour cost has gone up from $25\%$ of the cost of raw material to $30\%$ of the cost of raw material. what percentage of the consumption of raw material be reduced to keep the cost the same as that before the increase?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, fractions set kar le pehle. $12.5\% = 1/8$, isliye shuruati Raw Material (RM) cost ko 80 maan le. Labour uski $25\%$ thi yani 20 thi. Total purani cost = 100. Naya RM $1/8$ se badha yani 90 ho gaya. Nayi Labour naye RM ka $30\%$ hai, yani $90 \times 0.3 = 27$. Total nayi cost = 117. Lekin hume cost 100 hi rakhni hai. Toh reduction kitna karna hai? 117 se wapas 100 par aana hai, yani 17 ki kami 117 par. $\frac{17}{117} \times 100 \approx 14.52\%$. Calculation dhyan se karni padegi yahan!

questions.q: The ratio of the number of boys and girls in a school is 7:5. If $65\%$ of the boys and $81\%$ of the girls are scholarship holders, then the percentage of students, who do not get scholarship, is
questions.s: Dekh bhai, ulta chalte hain. Jo scholarship HOLD nahi karte unka % pucha hai. Boys me $100 - 65 = 35\%$ honge, Girls me $100 - 81 = 19\%$ hongi. Ab JSM (Weighted Average) laga de. $(7 \times 35 + 5 \times 19) / 12 = (245 + 95) / 12 = 340 / 12 = 85 / 3$. Isko mixed fraction me likhenge toh $28 \frac{1}{3}\%$ aayega. direct approach se paper nikalta hai!

questions.q: The present population of a village is 45,840. If the number of males increases by $25\%$ and that of females increases by $15\%$, then the population of the village will become 55,284. What is the difference between the number of males and that of females in the present population of the village?
questions.s: Dekh bhai TestRipper, ye data SSC ke ek flawed paper se hai! Concept JSM ka hai: Total increase = $55284 - 45840 = 9444$. Agar sab $15\%$ se badhte toh $45840 \times 15\% = 6876$ ka increase aata. Jo extra increase ($9444 - 6876 = 2568$) aaya, wo Males ke extra $10\%$ ki wajah se aaya! Toh $10\%$ of Males = 2568 $\implies$ Males = 25680. Females = $45840 - 25680 = 20160$. Exact diff = 5520 aayega, jo options me hai hi nahi! Aise question ko exam me chhodna ya koi ek mark karke challenge karna hota hai. Yahan Option elimination irrelevant hai.

questions.q: In a village there are two candidate in an election . If $20\%$ of the total voters do not cast their vote and 1792 votes are invaild than the winner candidate got $42\%$ of total votes and won by 3584 votes . If there is a city Lucknow and the number of voters in Lucknow is 3 times the number of total voters of the village and in city election 4400 votes are invaild and the winner candidate out of the two candidate got $58\%$ of the total vaild votes than what is the difference between the number of vaild votes got by the winner and the looser candidate?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, itna lamba essay hai par breakdown asaan hai! Village me Total = T. Polled = 0.8T. Valid = $0.8T - 1792$. Winner = 0.42T. Loser = Valid - Winner = $(0.8T - 1792) - 0.42T = 0.38T - 1792$. Margin = Winner - Loser = $0.42T - (0.38T - 1792) = 0.04T + 1792$. Margin 3584 diya hai, toh $0.04T = 1792 \implies T = 44800$. Ab Lucknow pe aaja: L = 3T = 134400. Invalid 4400, toh Valid = 130000. Winner = $58\%$ of Valid, Loser = $42\%$ of Valid. Difference pucha hai: $58 - 42 = 16\%$. Kiska $16\%$? Valid ka (130000). $130000 \times 16\% = 20800$. Darne ka nahi, solve karne ka!

questions.q: The monthly salary of a person was 50,000. He used to spend on three heads-personal and family expenses (E), taxes (T), philanthropy (P), and rest were his savings. E was $50\%$ of the income. T was $20\%$ of E and P was $15\%$ of T. When his salary got raised by $40\%$, he maintained the percentage level of E, but T became $30\%$ of E and P became $20\%$ of T.By what percentage is the new savings more or less than the earlier savings? (correct up to one decimal place)
questions.s: Dekh bhai, 50k ki value hata, base 100 maan ke solve kar! Old Base (I=100): E=50, T=10, P=1.5. Total Kharch = 61.5, Old Saving = 38.5. New Base (I=140): 'Maintained the % level' matlab E nayi income ka $50\%$ hi rahega, toh E=70. Naya T = E ka $30\% = 21$. Naya P = T ka $20\% = 4.2$. Total Kharch = 95.2. Nayi Saving = $140 - 95.2 = 44.8$. Saving kitni badhi? $44.8 - 38.5 = 6.3$. Percentage increase: $(6.3 / 38.5) \times 100 \approx 16.36\%$. Option D mark kar aur aage nikal.

questions.q: If the price of rice is raised by $28\%$, then by how much per cent should a person reduce his consumption of rice, so that his expenditure remains the same?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, Price aur Consumption inversely proportional hote hain jab kharcha fix ho! Price 100 se 128 ho gaya. Ab purane budget pe aane ke liye consumption ko 128 se wapas 100 karna padega. Kitni kami karni hai? 28 ki kami 128 par! Percentage me = $\frac{28}{128} \times 100 = \frac{7}{32} \times 100$. Ab isko solve karenge toh $21.875\%$ aayega. Exact values match karni thi!

questions.q: A quality control officer tracks the defect rates in 4 different machines in a textile factory. The first machine's defect rate is $1.8\%$, the second is $2.4\%$, and the third is $1.6\%$. The total defective output of the first three is 0.92 units. If the total number of defective units from all four machines is 4.12 and each machine's production is identical, find the defect percentage of the fourth machine. (CHSL TIER I - 21/11/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s: Dekh bhai, thoda sa wording me jhol hai. 'Total defective output of first three is 3.2 units' hona chahiye tha and 'Total of all four is 4.12' tabhi calculation set baithi hai. Maan le swap hua hai. Pehle 3 ka defect rate sum $= 1.8 + 2.4 + 1.6 = 5.8\%$. Unke total defective unit 3.2 the toh $P \times 5.8\% = 3.2 \implies P = 3.2 / 0.058$. Chauthe machine ke defective kitne honge? $4.12 - 3.2 = 0.92$. Uska rate nikal: $(0.92 / P) \times 100$. Values dalne par $0.92 \times 0.058 / 3.2 \times 100 = 1.6675\%$. Error pakadna bhi aana chahiye!

questions.q: In a class of 212 students, each student studies at least one of the three subjects Mandarin, French and Spanish. 96 of them study Mandarin, 102 studies French and 106 Spanish. 32 studies Mandarin and French, 34 study Mandarin and Spanish and 36 study French and Spanish. How many students study all the three subjects?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, pure set theory formula ka game hai! $A \cup B \cup C = n(A) + n(B) + n(C) - n(A \cap B) - n(B \cap C) - n(C \cap A) + n(A \cap B \cap C)$. Yahan sab koi kuch na kuch padhta hai, isliye union 212 hi hoga. Equation me daal: $212 = 96 + 102 + 106 - 32 - 34 - 36 + x$. Solve karega toh $212 = 304 - 102 + x \implies 212 = 202 + x \implies x = 10$. Bilkul straight forward sawal!

questions.q: The salaries of P and Q together amount to 9,60,000. P and Q save $64\%$ and $44\%$, respectively of their individual salaries. If P's expenditure is 1.5 times Q's expenditure, then what is the ratio of P's salary to Q's salary?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, Salary ka distribution seedha Expenditiure se nikal. Agar P $64\%$ save karta hai, toh kharch $36\%$ karta hai. Q ka kharch $100-44 = 56\%$ hai. Equation de rakhi hai: Exp(P) = 1.5 Exp(Q). Toh $36\% \times P = 1.5 \times 56\% \times Q$. Yaani $0.36P = 0.84Q$. Ratio P:Q = $84/36 = 7/3$. Seedha option D mark kar, 9,60,000 ka isme koi role hi nahi tha, confusion ke liye diya tha!

questions.q: The income of A is $45\%$ more than the income of B and the income of C is $60\%$ less than sum of the incomes of A and B. The income of D is $20\%$ more than of C. If the difference between the incomes of B and D is $\text{Rs. } 13,200$, then the income (in Rs.) of C is:
questions.s: Dekh bhai, series set kar puri. B ko 100 maan, toh A = 145. C unke sum ($245$) se $60\%$ kam hai, yani C = $40\%$ of $245 = 98$. D, C se $20\%$ zyada hai, yani D = $1.2 \times 98 = 117.6$. Ab B aur D ka difference dekh: $117.6 - 100 = 17.6$ units. Ye value de rakhi hai 13200. $17.6\text{ units} = 13200 \implies 1\text{ unit} = 750$. Pucha hai C ki income ($98\text{ units}$). $98 \times 750 = 73500$. Number tree strong hona chahiye!

questions.q: The number of male employees in company A is $71.42\%$ of the total number of employees in that company and the total number of employees in company B is $14.28\%$ less than of the employees in company A . If the number of male employees in company A is (x+12) more than that of female employees, and the total number of employees in company B is 84. then find the value of x?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, percentages ko fractions me convert kar! $71.42\% = 5/7$ aur $14.28\% = 1/7$. Company B ke log Company A se 1/7 kam hain, yani $B = 6/7 \times A$. Total B = 84 de rakha hai, toh $6/7 \times A = 84 \implies A = 98$. Company A me Male = $5/7 \times 98 = 70$. Toh Female hongi $98 - 70 = 28$. Equation di hai ki Male, Female se $(x+12)$ zyada hain. Toh $70 - 28 = x + 12 \implies 42 = x + 12 \implies x = 30$. Ekdum makkhan calculations!

questions.q: The expenditure of a household on food, clothing, and entertainment is in the ratio 2:4: 4. In the coming year, the cost of food is expected to fall by $10\%$, clothing to rise by $5\%$, and entertainment to fall by $15\%$.What is the percent change (increase or decrease) in the total household expenditure? (CGL TIER I- 12/09/2025 - SHIFT 3)
questions.s: Dekh bhai, JSM zindabad! Ratio 2:4:4 ko kaat ke 1:2:2 kar le, calculations asaan hongi. Ab weighted average laga de. $(1 \times (-10) + 2 \times (+5) + 2 \times (-15)) / (1+2+2)$. Ye banega $(-10 + 10 - 30) / 5 = -30 / 5 = -6\%$. Minus aaya matlab seedha decrease! Decrease by $6\%$. Pen uthane ki zarurat padti hai isme?

questions.q: Income of Ram is $25\%$ more than the expenditure of Shyam. Income of Shyam is $33.33\%$ more than the expenditure of Ram. If the savings of Shyam is $\text{Rs. } 3750$ more than that of Ram and the ratio between income and savings of Ram is 5:1, respectively, if the income of Shyam is (2x+10000), the find the value of 3x.
questions.s: Dekh bhai, relations track kar. Ram ka Income:Saving = 5:1. Toh Ram ka Exp(R) = 4 units. Equation 2: Shyam ki Income(S) Ram ke Exp(4) se 33.33% (1/3) zyada hai, yani $I_s = 4 \times (4/3) = 16/3$ units. Equation 1: Ram ki Income(5) Shyam ke Exp se 25% (1/4) zyada hai. Toh $I_r = 1.25 \times E_s \implies 5 = 1.25 \times E_s \implies E_s = 4$ units. Shyam ki Saving $S_s = I_s - E_s = 16/3 - 4 = 4/3$ units. Ram ki Saving $S_r = 1$ unit. Dono me diff = $4/3 - 1 = 1/3$ unit. Ye diff 3750 diya hai, toh $1\text{ unit} = 11250$. Shyam ki Income $I_s = 16/3 \times 11250 = 60000$. Ab $(2x + 10000) = 60000 \implies 2x = 50000 \implies x = 25000$. Pucha 3x hai, toh $3 \times 25000 = 75000$. Badiya link kiya hai variables ko!

questions.q: In an examination of 2 subjects – Maths and Reasoning, $24\%$ of students failed in Maths and $27\%$ of students failed in Reasoning. If $12\%$ of students failed in both the subjects, then find percentage of students passed in both the subjects.
questions.s: Dekh bhai, free ke number wali set theory hai. Total fail log nikal le jo atleast kisi ek me fail hue hon. Union = $A + B - \text{Both} = 24 + 27 - 12 = 39\%$. Agar $39\%$ log class me rotlu hain (fail hue), toh baki ke pass honge. Pass in both = $100 - 39 = 61\%$. Seedha tick kar aur aage nikal.

questions.q: The price of a product is decreased by x% and then increased by x%. The final price becomes $10\%$ less than the original. Find the value of x (approximately). (CGL TIER I - 24/09/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s: Dekh bhai, jab utna hi increase aur utna hi decrease ho, toh overall hamesha LOSS hi hota hai jiska formula $-x^2 / 100 \%$ hota hai. Question kehta hai ye net effect $10\%$ ka hai. Toh $x^2 / 100 = 10 \implies x^2 = 1000$. 1000 ka square root nikaloge toh 31 aur 32 ke beech aayega ($31^2 = 961, 32^2 = 1024$). Options dekho, 31.6 ekdum perfect baithega!

questions.q: If $25\%$ of half of x is equal to 2.5 times the value of $30\%$ of one-fourth of y, then x is what percent more or less than y?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, bas equation ko theek se likhna hai. $\frac{1}{4} \times \frac{x}{2} = 2.5 \times \frac{30}{100} \times \frac{y}{4}$. Yani $\frac{x}{8} = 2.5 \times 0.3 \times \frac{y}{4}$. Isko solve kar, $\frac{x}{8} = 0.75 \times \frac{y}{4} \implies \frac{x}{8} = \frac{3}{4} \times \frac{y}{4} = \frac{3y}{16}$. Cut-pit kar de: $x = \frac{24y}{16} = 1.5y$. Matlab x, y se dedh guna hai. Ek hi chiz ko 1.5 times karna matlab usko $50\%$ zyada karna. Toh $50\%$ more!

questions.q: The salary of a person is $\text{Rs. } 30,000$. It increases by 2k% in the first year and successively increases by k% in the next year, his salary becomes $\text{Rs. } 44,850$. If the salary of the person decreases by 2k% in the first year and successively decreases by k% in the next year, then his salary would have been:
questions.s: Dekh bhai, successive polynomial ka badhiya sawal. $30000(1+2k)(1+k) = 44850$. Divide karega toh $(1+2k)(1+k) = 1.495$ aayega. Options ya logic se guess maar, agar $k=15\%$ ho, toh ye $(1.3)(1.15)$ banega. Multiply kar $1.3 \times 1.15 = 1.495$. Exact match! Ab decrements apply kar de: pehle $30\%$ decrease aur phir $15\%$ decrease. $30000 \times 0.70 \times 0.85 = 21000 \times 0.85 = 17850$. Value hit trial se jaldi niklega, quad equation mat banate baithna!
